title: Elegant Spicy Japanese Chickpea Tamagoyaki
description: A spicy and bouncy Japanese dish featuring chickpea flour, perfect for meal prep, made with a pasta-water emulsion and low-sodium friendly ingredients, formed into a tamagoyaki shape.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chickpea flour, water, pasta water, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Add diced green chili, low-sodium soy sauce, sesame oil, and grated ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Heat a non-stick tamagoyaki pan over medium heat and brush with a small amount of sesame oil.
Pour about 1/4 cup of the chickpea mixture into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tamagoyaki towards the center as it cooks.
When the bottom is lightly browned, use the spatula to carefully roll the tamagoyaki away from you.
Repeat the process until all the mixture is used up, forming multiple tamagoyaki rolls.
Serve the tamagoyaki warm or at room temperature, garnished with grated daikon and shiso leaves if desired.
